property_summary: After any call to SetMinSum, the value of MinSum must be equal to the argument supplied in that call; the mutant never updates MinSum, so after a non-zero call MinSum remains its prior value while the argument is different.
change_summary: Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from SetMinSum, which may change reentrancy behavior but not directly the stored MinSum value—this edit does NOT guarantee observable difference in MinSum after call, so EXCLUDED. Instead, replace the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' with a no-op 'uint x = _val;' so MinSum never changes.
